description: This file contains unit tests for verifying the correct usage of custom tokenizers within the litellm framework, specifically targeting bug fixes related to custom_tokenizer extraction from model_info and ensuring the correct tokenizer (HuggingFace vs. OpenAI) is used during token counting for different models and scenarios.

methods.name: test_custom_tokenizer_from_model_info()
methods.description: Verifies that the custom_tokenizer specified in model_info is correctly used during token counting, instead of falling back to the default OpenAI tokenizer.

methods.name: test_custom_tokenizer_with_llamacpp()
methods.description: Checks that a model with a specified custom_tokenizer correctly uses the HuggingFace tokenizer in a local llamacpp environment.

methods.name: test_multilingual_e5_embedding_model()
methods.description: Confirms that for a multilingual embedding model using the intfloat/multilingual-e5-large-instruct tokenizer, the system uses the HuggingFace tokenizer.

methods.name: test_model_without_custom_tokenizer_uses_default()
methods.description: Ensures that models without a specified custom_tokenizer default to the standard OpenAI tokenizer.
